Title: Azure Cognitive Services Translator Text— Assamese language now available

Body.Content:
You can now add Assamese text translation into your apps, products, and workflows with Translator. Translate to or from Assamese into any of the more than 70 languages available in Translator. Learn more about this language release in the Translator blog.

See more information on other languages that Translator supports.
